<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are all except the carbonyl‑like peak at 166.40 ppm and the aliphatic peak at 52.24 ppm. Counting those peaks gives 16 aromatic carbon signals, corresponding to 16 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>16</final_answer>
